user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and navigational search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Pages visited when users ask questions or interact via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for training generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content directed by Claude user queries.
user_agents.scope: Sites accessed through user-initiated queries to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance search response relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google's search indexes and perform product-specific crawls and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for Search testing tools like URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams to fetch publicly accessible web content.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development and various product teams; no specific product affected.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl sites as requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content usage for Gemini model training and search grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Collects web data either automatically or in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Spotlight, Siri, and Safari, and crawls web data.
user_agents.scope: Web search crawling and rendering, providing data for search and generative AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models for generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Determines how data crawled by Applebot is used; does not crawl webpages directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display previews.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for training foundation AI models and improving products.
user_agents.scope: Training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request supporting agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Evaluating and improving agentic AI capabilities, including navigating websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build the Bing search index and power AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawling and indexing for Bing search results and Microsoft Copilot AI experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow bingbot in robots.txt or use Bing Webmaster Tools.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates snapshots and previews of web pages for search and AI services.
user_agents.scope: Page preview and snapshot generation for Bing search and Microsoft services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for Amazon products, services, and AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawl web content for search experiences; does not train generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives for Amzn-SearchBot or general search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions and fetches live information for Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetching initiated by users; not for AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide free crawl datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated sampling of public web pages for open research datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt with User-agent: CCBot or join the opt-out registry.
